# AI Creates AI

> AI Creates AI is the parent company behind EVE CXO. Adam is the company's internal executive intelligence, Eve is the customer-facing executive intelligence inside EVE CXO, and Hermes is the shared durable orchestration/runtime foundation beneath both.

## Ecosystem

- **AI Creates AI** — parent company and builder of the ecosystem.
- **EVE CXO** — commercial customer product: the AI Operating System for Business.
- **Adam** — internal executive intelligence for AI Creates AI.
- **Eve** — customer-facing executive intelligence and chief-of-staff layer inside EVE CXO.
- **Hermes** — shared orchestration/runtime for task state, delegation, approvals, evidence, and durable execution.

EVE CXO is organized around seven customer-facing departments: Marketing, Sales & Acquisition, Advertising, Finance, Operations, Legal & Compliance, and Development & Engineering. Consequential actions remain subject to permissions and human approval.
